/* ========================================================================
   EDFM mobile drawer Echo badge icon fix — 2026-08-26
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MonoBook's mobile drawer moves the Echo alert/notice links around with JS.
   The drawer's generic mobile link styling can make the OOUI badge anchors
   expand and expose the underlying icon sprite sheet, which appears as giant
   repeated bell/tray glyphs across the Personal tools drawer. Keep the two
   icon-only Echo badges constrained while preserving the combined
   "Notifications" drawer link.
   ======================================================================== */
@media screen and ( max-width: 550px ) {
	#echo-hack-badges,
	#echo-hack-badges li,
	#echo-hack-badges #pt-notifications-alert,
	#echo-hack-badges #pt-notifications-notice {
		box-sizing: border-box !important;
		list-style: none !important;
		list-style-image: none !important;
		margin: 0 !important;
		padding: 0 !important;
	}

	#echo-hack-badges #pt-notifications-alert,
	#echo-hack-badges #pt-notifications-notice {
		display: inline-block !important;
		height: 22px !important;
		line-height: 22px !important;
		overflow: hidden !important;
		vertical-align: top !important;
		width: 22px !important;
	}

	#echo-hack-badges #pt-notifications-alert > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge,
	#echo-hack-badges #pt-notifications-notice > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge,
	#p-personal.mobile-menu-active #pt-notifications-alert > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge,
	#p-personal.mobile-menu-active #pt-notifications-notice > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge {
		background-position: 50% 50% !important;
		background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
		background-size: 20px 20px !important;
		box-sizing: border-box !important;
		color: transparent !important;
		display: block !important;
		font-size: 0 !important;
		height: 22px !important;
		line-height: 22px !important;
		margin: 0 !important;
		max-height: 22px !important;
		max-width: 22px !important;
		min-height: 22px !important;
		min-width: 22px !important;
		overflow: hidden !important;
		padding: 0 !important;
		text-indent: -9999px !important;
		width: 22px !important;
	}

	#echo-hack-badges #pt-notifications-alert > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge > span,
	#echo-hack-badges #pt-notifications-notice > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge > span,
	#p-personal.mobile-menu-active #pt-notifications-alert > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge > span,
	#p-personal.mobile-menu-active #pt-notifications-notice > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge > span {
		display: none !important;
	}

	#echo-hack-badges #pt-notifications-alert > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge::before,
	#echo-hack-badges #pt-notifications-notice > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge::before,
	#p-personal.mobile-menu-active #pt-notifications-alert > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge::before,
	#p-personal.mobile-menu-active #pt-notifications-notice > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge::before {
		display: none !important;
	}

	#echo-hack-badges #pt-notifications-alert > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge::after,
	#echo-hack-badges #pt-notifications-notice > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge::after,
	#p-personal.mobile-menu-active #pt-notifications-alert > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge::after,
	#p-personal.mobile-menu-active #pt-notifications-notice > a.mw-echo-notifications-badge::after {
		font-size: 10px !important;
		left: 10px !important;
		line-height: 1 !important;
		padding: 1px 3px !important;
		top: 10px !important;
	}

	/* If Echo has not finished moving these two icon links into #echo-hack-badges,
	   do not let them participate in the drawer's large text layout. */
	#p-personal.mobile-menu-active > ul > #pt-notifications-alert,
	#p-personal.mobile-menu-active > ul > #pt-notifications-notice,
	#p-personal.mobile-menu-active .pBody > ul > #pt-notifications-alert,
	#p-personal.mobile-menu-active .pBody > ul > #pt-notifications-notice,
	#p-personal.mobile-menu-active .vector-menu-content-list > #pt-notifications-alert,
	#p-personal.mobile-menu-active .vector-menu-content-list > #pt-notifications-notice {
		display: inline-block !important;
		height: 22px !important;
		line-height: 22px !important;
		margin: 0 0.45em 0 0 !important;
		max-width: 22px !important;
		overflow: hidden !important;
		padding: 0 !important;
		vertical-align: middle !important;
		width: 22px !important;
	}
}

/* ========================================================================
   EDFM GALNET FEED MODULE
   ======================================================================== */
.edfm-galnet-panel {
	position: relative;
	margin: 1rem 0 1.8rem;
	padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	background:
		linear-gradient( 135deg, rgba( 66, 199, 217, 0.10 ), transparent 36% ),
		linear-gradient( 315deg, rgba( 255, 138, 0, 0.06 ), transparent 48% ),
		var( --edfm-surface-2 );
	border: 1px solid var( --edfm-border );
	border-left: 4px solid var( --edfm-cyan );
	box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba( 0, 0, 0, 0.24 );
	overflow: hidden;
}
.edfm-galnet-panel::before {
	content: '';
	position: absolute;
	inset: 0 0 auto 0;
	height: 2px;
	background: linear-gradient( 90deg, var( --edfm-cyan ), rgba( 255, 138, 0, 0.28 ), transparent );
	pointer-events: none;
}
.edfm-galnet-feed,
.edfm-galnet-archive-list {
	display: grid;
	gap: 0.8rem;
}
.edfm-galnet-feed {
	grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}
.edfm-galnet-item,
.edfm-galnet-archive-entry {
	position: relative;
	padding: 0.72rem 0.85rem;
	background: rgba( 9, 14, 18, 0.58 );
	border: 1px solid var( --edfm-border-soft );
	border-left: 2px solid rgba( 66, 199, 217, 0.72 );
	box-sizing: border-box;
	transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
}
.edfm-galnet-item:hover,
.edfm-galnet-archive-entry:hover {
	background: rgba( 13, 22, 28, 0.86 );
	border-color: rgba( 66, 199, 217, 0.48 );
	transform: translateY( -1px );
}
.edfm-galnet-date,
.edfm-galnet-source {
	color: var( --edfm-text-dim );
	font-family: var( --edfm-mono );
	font-size: var( --edfm-fs-meta );
	font-weight: 800;
	letter-spacing: 0.09em;
	line-height: 1.25;
	text-transform: uppercase;
}
.edfm-galnet-headline,
.edfm-galnet-headline a {
	margin-top: 0.28rem;
	color: var( --edfm-text ) !important;
	font-family: var( --edfm-mono );
	font-size: 1rem;
	font-weight: 800;
	line-height: 1.3;
	text-decoration: none;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.edfm-galnet-headline a:hover,
.edfm-galnet-headline a:focus {
	color: var( --edfm-cyan-bright ) !important;
	text-decoration: underline;
	text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
	text-underline-offset: 0.18em;
}
.edfm-galnet-summary {
	margin-top: 0.42rem;
	color: var( --edfm-text-muted );
	font-size: 0.94rem;
	line-height: 1.55;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.edfm-galnet-source {
	margin-top: 0.55rem;
	letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}
.edfm-galnet-footer {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 1rem;
	margin-top: 0.9rem;
	padding-top: 0.75rem;
	border-top: 1px solid var( --edfm-border-soft );
	color: var( --edfm-text-dim );
	font-family: var( --edfm-mono );
	font-size: var( --edfm-fs-meta );
	line-height: 1.45;
}
.edfm-galnet-more {
	flex: 0 0 auto;
	font-weight: 800;
	letter-spacing: 0.05em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
}
.edfm-galnet-more a,
.edfm-galnet-source a {
	color: var( --edfm-link ) !important;
}
.edfm-galnet-more a:hover,
.edfm-galnet-more a:focus,
.edfm-galnet-source a:hover,
.edfm-galnet-source a:focus {
	color: var( --edfm-orange-bright ) !important;
}
.edfm-galnet-panel-archive .edfm-galnet-archive-list {
	gap: 0.95rem;
}
.edfm-galnet-official-note,
.edfm-galnet-future-note {
	margin: 1rem 0;
	padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
	background: var( --edfm-surface-2 );
	border: 1px solid var( --edfm-border );
	border-left: 3px solid var( --edfm-cyan );
	color: var( --edfm-text-muted );
	line-height: 1.55;
}
.edfm-galnet-future-note {
	border-left-color: var( --edfm-orange );
}
@media ( min-width: 980px ) {
	.edfm-galnet-panel-latest .edfm-galnet-feed {
		grid-template-columns: repeat( 2, minmax( 0, 1fr ) );
	}
	.edfm-galnet-panel-latest .edfm-galnet-item:first-child {
		grid-row: span 2;
	}
}
@media ( max-width: 760px ) {
	.edfm-galnet-panel {
		padding: 0.85rem;
	}
	.edfm-galnet-item,
	.edfm-galnet-archive-entry {
		padding: 0.68rem 0.75rem;
	}
	.edfm-galnet-footer {
		align-items: flex-start;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: 0.45rem;
	}
	.edfm-galnet-more {
		white-space: normal;
	}
}

/* ========================================================================
   EDFM GALNET MARQUEE OVERRIDE
   ======================================================================== */
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee {
	padding: 0.82rem 0.95rem 0.78rem;
}
.edfm-galnet-marquee-label {
	margin-bottom: 0.55rem;
	color: var( --edfm-text-dim );
	font-family: var( --edfm-mono );
	font-size: var( --edfm-fs-meta );
	font-weight: 800;
	letter-spacing: 0.14em;
	line-height: 1;
	text-transform: uppercase;
}
.edfm-galnet-marquee-window {
	position: relative;
	width: 100%;
	min-height: 2.65rem;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	background: rgba( 9, 14, 18, 0.72 );
	border: 1px solid var( --edfm-border-soft );
	border-left: 2px solid rgba( 66, 199, 217, 0.82 );
	overflow: hidden;
}
.edfm-galnet-marquee-window::before,
.edfm-galnet-marquee-window::after {
	content: '';
	position: absolute;
	top: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	z-index: 2;
	width: 2.25rem;
	pointer-events: none;
}
.edfm-galnet-marquee-window::before {
	left: 0;
	background: linear-gradient( 90deg, rgba( 9, 14, 18, 0.98 ), transparent );
}
.edfm-galnet-marquee-window::after {
	right: 0;
	background: linear-gradient( 270deg, rgba( 9, 14, 18, 0.98 ), transparent );
}
.edfm-galnet-marquee-track {
	display: inline-flex;
	align-items: stretch;
	gap: 1.05rem;
	width: max-content;
	min-width: 100%;
	padding: 0.6rem 2.2rem;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	white-space: nowrap;
	animation: edfm-galnet-marquee-scroll 72s linear infinite;
}
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee:hover .edfm-galnet-marquee-track,
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee:focus-within .edfm-galnet-marquee-track {
	animation-play-state: paused;
}
.edfm-galnet-marquee-segment {
	display: inline-flex;
	align-items: stretch;
	gap: 1.05rem;
	min-width: max-content;
}
.edfm-galnet-marquee-segment[aria-hidden="true"] {
	margin-left: 1.05rem;
}
.edfm-galnet-ticker-item {
	display: inline-flex;
	align-items: baseline;
	gap: 0.55rem;
	max-width: min( 68vw, 48rem );
	color: var( --edfm-text-muted );
	line-height: 1.35;
}
.edfm-galnet-ticker-item::after {
	content: '//';
	color: rgba( 255, 138, 0, 0.62 );
	font-family: var( --edfm-mono );
	font-weight: 800;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.edfm-galnet-ticker-item .edfm-galnet-date {
	flex: 0 0 auto;
	color: var( --edfm-cyan-bright );
	font-size: 0.76rem;
	letter-spacing: 0.1em;
}
.edfm-galnet-ticker-item .edfm-galnet-headline,
.edfm-galnet-ticker-item .edfm-galnet-headline a {
	margin-top: 0;
	color: var( --edfm-text ) !important;
	font-size: 0.95rem;
	white-space: nowrap;
}
.edfm-galnet-ticker-item .edfm-galnet-headline a:hover,
.edfm-galnet-ticker-item .edfm-galnet-headline a:focus {
	color: var( --edfm-orange-bright ) !important;
	outline: 1px solid rgba( 66, 199, 217, 0.55 );
	outline-offset: 0.16rem;
}
.edfm-galnet-ticker-item .edfm-galnet-summary {
	max-width: 24rem;
	margin-top: 0;
	font-size: 0.88rem;
	line-height: 1.35;
	white-space: nowrap;
	overflow: hidden;
	text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
@keyframes edfm-galnet-marquee-scroll {
	0% {
		transform: translateX( 0 );
	}
	100% {
		transform: translateX( -50% );
	}
}
@media ( prefers-reduced-motion: reduce ) {
	.edfm-galnet-marquee-track {
		animation: none;
		transform: none;
	}
	.edfm-galnet-marquee-window {
		overflow-x: auto;
	}
}
@media ( max-width: 760px ) {
	.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee {
		padding: 0.75rem 0.78rem;
	}
	.edfm-galnet-marquee-track {
		gap: 0.9rem;
		padding: 0.56rem 1.55rem;
		animation-duration: 88s;
	}
	.edfm-galnet-ticker-item {
		max-width: 33rem;
		gap: 0.45rem;
	}
	.edfm-galnet-ticker-item .edfm-galnet-summary {
		max-width: 14rem;
	}
}

/* GalNet marquee v2: new class avoids stale browser-cached first marquee animation. */
.edfm-galnet-marquee-track-v2 {
	display: inline-flex;
	align-items: stretch;
	gap: 1.05rem;
	width: max-content;
	min-width: 100%;
	padding: 0.6rem 2.2rem;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	white-space: nowrap;
	animation: edfm-galnet-marquee-scroll-v2 84s linear infinite;
}
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee:hover .edfm-galnet-marquee-track-v2,
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee:focus-within .edfm-galnet-marquee-track-v2,
.edfm-galnet-marquee:hover .edfm-galnet-marquee-track-v2,
.edfm-galnet-marquee:focus-within .edfm-galnet-marquee-track-v2,
.edfm-galnet-marquee-window:hover .edfm-galnet-marquee-track-v2,
.edfm-galnet-marquee-window:focus-within .edfm-galnet-marquee-track-v2 {
	animation-play-state: paused;
}
@keyframes edfm-galnet-marquee-scroll-v2 {
	0% { transform: translateX( 0 ); }
	100% { transform: translateX( -50% ); }
}
@media ( prefers-reduced-motion: reduce ) {
	.edfm-galnet-marquee-track-v2 {
		animation: none;
		transform: none;
	}
}
@media ( max-width: 760px ) {
	.edfm-galnet-marquee-track-v2 {
		gap: 0.9rem;
		padding: 0.56rem 1.55rem;
		animation-duration: 96s;
	}
}

/* GalNet marquee compact layout: heading + ticker + View All only. */
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee {
	margin: 0.35rem 0 0.85rem;
	padding: 0.42rem 0.55rem 0.46rem;
	border-left-width: 3px;
	box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba( 0, 0, 0, 0.18 );
}
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee .edfm-galnet-marquee-label {
	display: none;
}
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee .edfm-galnet-marquee-window {
	min-height: 2.25rem;
}
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee .edfm-galnet-marquee-track-v2 {
	padding-top: 0.46rem;
	padding-bottom: 0.46rem;
}
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee .edfm-galnet-footer-compact {
	display: block;
	margin-top: 0.42rem;
	padding-top: 0;
	border-top: 0;
	line-height: 1.15;
}
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee .edfm-galnet-footer-compact .edfm-galnet-more {
	display: inline-block;
	font-size: 0.78rem;
	letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}
@media ( max-width: 760px ) {
	.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee {
		margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
		padding: 0.38rem 0.45rem 0.44rem;
	}
	.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee .edfm-galnet-marquee-window {
		min-height: 2.2rem;
	}
}

/* GalNet marquee micro-compact: remove MediaWiki paragraph chrome inside generated ticker. */
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee .edfm-galnet-marquee-track-v2 > p {
	display: contents;
	margin: 0;
}
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee .edfm-galnet-footer-compact p {
	margin: 0;
	line-height: 1;
}
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee .edfm-galnet-marquee-track-v2 {
	padding-top: 0.36rem;
	padding-bottom: 0.36rem;
}
.edfm-galnet-panel-marquee .edfm-galnet-footer-compact {
	margin-top: 0.28rem;
}

/* GalNet latest no-box strip: page heading, marquee, View All only. */
.edfm-galnet-strip-latest {
	margin: 0.15rem 0 1.1rem;
	padding: 0;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	box-shadow: none;
}
.edfm-galnet-strip-latest .edfm-galnet-marquee-window {
	min-height: 1.8rem;
	padding: 0;
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: 0;
	box-shadow: none;
	overflow: hidden;
}
.edfm-galnet-strip-latest .edfm-galnet-marquee-track-v2 {
	padding: 0.18rem 0;
}
.edfm-galnet-strip-latest .edfm-galnet-marquee-track-v2 > p {
	display: contents;
	margin: 0;
}
.edfm-galnet-strip-latest .edfm-galnet-ticker-item {
	background: transparent;
	border: 0;
	box-shadow: none;
	padding-top: 0;
	padding-bottom: 0;
}
.edfm-galnet-strip-latest .edfm-galnet-footer-compact {
	display: block;
	margin-top: 0.2rem;
	padding: 0;
	border: 0;
	line-height: 1;
}
.edfm-galnet-strip-latest .edfm-galnet-footer-compact p {
	margin: 0;
	line-height: 1;
}
.edfm-galnet-strip-latest .edfm-galnet-more {
	display: inline-block;
	font-size: 0.78rem;
	letter-spacing: 0.08em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* Topic-card section headings: make Browse-by-topic H3 anchors appear as card titles while remaining visible in the top contents list. */
.edfm-home-grid-topics .edfm-home-card .mw-heading3 {
	margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
	padding: 0;
	border: 0;
	background: transparent;
}

.edfm-home-grid-topics .edfm-home-card .mw-heading3 h3 {
	margin: 0;
	padding: 0;
	border: 0;
	font: inherit;
	font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace);
	font-size: 1rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.35;
	color: var(--color-text, #e5edf0);
}

.edfm-home-grid-topics .edfm-home-card .mw-heading3::after {
	display: none;
}

/* Homepage focused jump navigation and live-content sections. */
.edfm-home-jump {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat( 4, minmax( 0, 1fr ) );
	gap: 0.55rem;
	margin: 1.2rem 0 1.9rem;
}
.edfm-home-jump a {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 0.55rem;
	min-height: 2.7rem;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	padding: 0.62rem 0.8rem;
	background: var( --edfm-surface-3 );
	border-left: 4px solid var( --edfm-orange );
	box-shadow: inset 1px 0 0 rgba( 255, 162, 26, 0.35 );
	color: var( --edfm-text-muted );
	font-family: var( --edfm-mono );
	font-weight: 800;
	letter-spacing: 0.055em;
	text-decoration: none;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
}
.edfm-home-jump a:hover,
.edfm-home-jump a:focus-visible {
	background: var( --edfm-surface-4 );
	border-left-color: var( --edfm-cyan );
	box-shadow: inset 1px 0 0 rgba( 66, 199, 217, 0.45 );
	color: var( --edfm-text );
	transform: translateY( -1px );
}
.edfm-home-jump-number {
	color: var( --edfm-orange );
	font-size: 1.02rem;
	line-height: 1;
}
.edfm-home-jump-text {
	font-size: 0.82rem;
	line-height: 1.25;
}
.edfm-home-section-intro {
	max-width: 74rem;
	margin: -0.25rem 0 1rem;
	color: var( --edfm-text-muted );
	font-size: 1rem;
	line-height: 1.6;
}
.edfm-home-procedure-list {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat( 3, minmax( 0, 1fr ) );
	gap: 0.85rem;
	margin: 1rem 0 0.75rem;
}
.edfm-home-procedure-card {
	position: relative;
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	min-height: 12.5rem;
	padding: 0.95rem 1rem 1rem;
	background: linear-gradient( 135deg, rgba( 66, 199, 217, 0.09 ), transparent 42% ), var( --edfm-surface-2 );
	border: 1px solid var( --edfm-border );
	border-top: 3px solid var( --edfm-cyan );
	box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba( 0, 0, 0, 0.2 );
	transition: background-color 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease;
}
.edfm-home-procedure-card:hover,
.edfm-home-procedure-card:focus-within {
	background: linear-gradient( 135deg, rgba( 255, 138, 0, 0.12 ), rgba( 66, 199, 217, 0.05 ) 46%, transparent 76% ), var( --edfm-surface-2 );
	border-color: rgba( 255, 162, 26, 0.72 );
	border-top-color: var( --edfm-orange );
	box-shadow: 0 16px 30px rgba( 0, 0, 0, 0.28 );
	transform: translateY( -3px );
}
.edfm-home-procedure-card:hover .edfm-home-procedure-title a,
.edfm-home-procedure-card:focus-within .edfm-home-procedure-title a,
.edfm-home-procedure-card:hover .edfm-home-procedure-action a,
.edfm-home-procedure-card:focus-within .edfm-home-procedure-action a {
	color: var( --edfm-orange-bright ) !important;
}
.edfm-home-procedure-card::after {
	content: "↗";
	position: absolute;
	right: 0.85rem;
	top: 0.72rem;
	color: rgba( 255, 162, 26, 0.68 );
	font-family: var( --edfm-mono );
	font-size: 1.05rem;
	font-weight: 800;
}
.edfm-home-procedure-card-primary {
	border-top-color: var( --edfm-orange );
}
.edfm-home-procedure-title,
.edfm-home-procedure-title a {
	margin-top: 0.38rem;
	color: var( --edfm-text ) !important;
	font-family: var( --edfm-mono );
	font-size: 1.02rem;
	font-weight: 800;
	line-height: 1.32;
	text-decoration: none;
}
.edfm-home-procedure-title a:hover,
.edfm-home-procedure-title a:focus-visible {
	color: var( --edfm-orange-bright ) !important;
}
.edfm-home-procedure-text {
	margin-top: 0.6rem;
	color: var( --edfm-text-muted );
	line-height: 1.55;
}

.edfm-home-procedure-action {
	margin-top: auto;
	padding-top: 0.9rem;
	font-family: var( --edfm-mono );
	font-size: 0.76rem;
	font-weight: 800;
	letter-spacing: 0.065em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
}
.edfm-home-procedure-action a {
	color: var( --edfm-orange ) !important;
	text-decoration: none;
}
.edfm-home-procedure-action a:hover,
.edfm-home-procedure-action a:focus-visible {
	color: var( --edfm-orange-bright ) !important;
	text-decoration: underline;
}
.edfm-home-section-link {
	margin: 0.8rem 0 2rem;
	padding-top: 0.65rem;
	border-top: 1px solid var( --edfm-border-soft );
	text-align: right;
	font-family: var( --edfm-mono );
	font-size: 0.82rem;
	font-weight: 800;
	letter-spacing: 0.055em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
}
.edfm-home-recent-list {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat( 2, minmax( 0, 1fr ) );
	gap: 0.65rem;
	margin: 0.95rem 0 0.75rem;
}
.edfm-home-recent-item {
	padding: 0.72rem 0.85rem;
	background: var( --edfm-surface-2 );
	border: 1px solid var( --edfm-border-soft );
	border-left: 3px solid var( --edfm-cyan );
	box-sizing: border-box;
	transition: background-color 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease;
}
.edfm-home-recent-item:hover,
.edfm-home-recent-item:focus-within {
	background: var( --edfm-surface-3 );
	border-color: rgba( 255, 162, 26, 0.62 );
	border-left-color: var( --edfm-orange );
	box-shadow: 0 14px 26px rgba( 0, 0, 0, 0.26 );
	transform: translateY( -2px );
}
.edfm-home-recent-item:hover .edfm-home-recent-title a,
.edfm-home-recent-item:focus-within .edfm-home-recent-title a {
	color: var( --edfm-orange-bright ) !important;
}
.edfm-home-recent-title,
.edfm-home-recent-title a {
	color: var( --edfm-text ) !important;
	font-family: var( --edfm-mono );
	font-weight: 800;
	line-height: 1.3;
	text-decoration: none;
}
.edfm-home-recent-title a:hover,
.edfm-home-recent-title a:focus-visible {
	color: var( --edfm-orange-bright ) !important;
}
.edfm-home-recent-meta {
	margin-top: 0.25rem;
	color: var( --edfm-orange );
	font-family: var( --edfm-mono );
	font-size: 0.74rem;
	font-weight: 800;
	letter-spacing: 0.065em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
}
.edfm-home-recent-summary {
	margin-top: 0.55rem;
	color: var( --edfm-text-muted );
	font-size: 0.92rem;
	line-height: 1.5;
}
@media ( max-width: 1100px ) {
	.edfm-home-jump,
	.edfm-home-procedure-list,
	.edfm-home-recent-list {
		grid-template-columns: repeat( 2, minmax( 0, 1fr ) );
	}
}
@media ( max-width: 760px ) {
	.edfm-home-jump,
	.edfm-home-procedure-list,
	.edfm-home-recent-list,
	.edfm-home-recent-item {
		grid-template-columns: 1fr;
	}
	.edfm-home-jump a {
		min-height: 2.9rem;
		padding: 0.72rem 0.9rem;
	}
	.edfm-home-section-link {
		text-align: left;
	}
}
